name: Village Herbalist
description: A gentle healer who uses forest herbs to mend light cuts and wounds.

name: Shrine Priest
description: A devout devotee capable of blessing allies with protective wards.

name: Divine Cleric
description: A sacred war priest whose holy light revitalizes exhausted champions.

name: Radiant Templar
description: A beacon of hope who cleanses afflictions and reinforces frontline defense.

name: High Priestess of Dawn
description: A revered herald of morning light who can resurrect fallen comrades in battle.

name: Avatar of Life
description: The sacred incarnation of vitality whose grace bestows eternal rejuvenation.
